Start with passive reconnaissance before moving to active scanning against a
client's scoped assets.

# Tooling

Use the following placeholders when documenting live findings against a client
engagement:

```
Target: <domain>
Operator: <user>
Source IP: <ip>
```

## Recommended tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| whois | domain registration lookup |
| amass | subdomain enumeration |

![Reconnaissance workflow diagram](images/recon-diagram.png)

See the [subdomain enumeration chapter](/books/web-application-testing/chapter/reconnaissance)
for the next step, and [the write-up](https://example.com/blog/recon) for background reading.
